_about: Hidden Stash (524; docs/notes/artefact-skills.md "Hidden Stash"): the artefact tree's row III, column 4 (beside Artifact Container), one rank: modifier 40 (artefact_power) bit 14, which srp keeps only on a kit whose pockets and containers are fewer than six and exe patch 109 reads: one artefact past the kit's containers, from the take that fills it to the holder's death. After artefact-skills-1.json. Name and description are st_srp_artefact_524_* in client-patches/localization.
